### Graduate outreach quick brief

- **Lewis & Clark — San Diego territory:** Lewis & Clark’s California-territory search result assigns **San Diego County to Qwadere Lovell**, **Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions**. Contact details: **qlovell@lclark.edu**, **503-713-1203**; regional base listed as **Los Angeles, California**.  
  - Note: I opened the Lewis & Clark county-territory URL surfaced by its admissions search result, but the live URL now returns a **404**, so I could not leave a functioning L&C territory page open. The live contact details were corroborated in the regional-admissions listing.

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW — Fall 2026 deadline:** On Silberman’s official **Deadlines** page, the Fall application deadline for the **Two-Year Full-Time, Dual Degree–Bank Street, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency MSW programs** is **March 1**; supporting documents are due **March 15**.  
  - **Open tab:** official Silberman deadline page.

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate offerings:** The official **Graduate Programs** page is open. Its currently rendered content identifies offerings at the level of **master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work**, but does **not expose the individual program names in the page’s visible text**. I have not inferred a program list beyond what the live official page displays.  
  - **Open tab:** official IU Kokomo Graduate Programs page.

- **UCSF recruiting glioblastoma trials — Northern California:**  
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — **Status: accepting new patients**; **UCSF, San Francisco, California 94143**. UCSF identifies it as a Phase 1 study, NCT06186401.  
     - **Open tab:** actual UCSF trial page.  
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **Status: accepting new patients**; locations include **UCSF, San Francisco, California 94143**, plus City of Hope in Duarte. UCSF identifies it as a Phase 2 study, NCT06805305.  
     - **Open tab:** actual UCSF trial page.  
  UCSF’s glioblastoma index currently states there are **16 open to eligible people**.

- **Oral Roberts University student-life contact:** ORU’s official Student Association result identifies **Augustine Mendoza** as **Director of Student Experience**, with **augiemendoza@oru.edu**. A phone number was not shown in that official result. ORU’s live Student Life “Meet the Team” page is open for visual confirmation of current student-life staffing; it lists **Bethany Smith, Assistant Director of Student Association**, at **besmith@oru.edu** and **918.495.6664**.

- **EDF Energy graduate programme / salary reviews:** I opened EDF’s current official **Graduate careers** page. It describes the graduate programme and current schemes, but **does not state whether new hires receive salary reviews**, so there is no exact salary-review wording on that live page to quote. I have not substituted wording from third-party job aggregators.  
  - **Open tab:** official EDF Graduate Careers page.

The Hunter, IU Kokomo, both UCSF trial pages, ORU Student Life page, and EDF Graduate Careers page remain open.
